method: freeze-deliverables.py.txt reads only the complete three own-angle segment trees, rejects symlinks/cache files, writes one freeze-manifest.json per segment, then rereads all declared files and checks the complete path set. The manifest lists every file except itself. No later writes within a frozen tree are permitted.
execution_status: This file records the method and intended final invocation, not a fabricated execution receipt. Actual execution and returned manifest pins are reported by the tool result and final handoff.
shared_evidence_boundary: Identical original and helper sources are retained once under 283; exact references in each segment and complete 283 freeze bind those shared bytes. All failed/superseded files and raw generator attempts are included.
